title: Playing with Cannonball Adderley
summary: Cannonball's musicianship and the piece Primitivo written to showcase Lateef.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Cannonball Adderley: the sound, the man, the band

blocks.x: ...businessman, saxophonist. He could elaborate on Stravinsky’s Rites of Spring...

It seemed that, and perhaps you agree, that group really seemed to uh...to really showcase your versatility, as well. I mean, there’s a, there’s a piece I remember– Primitivo–from that ensemble, it just, it seemed that it was just a wonderful extension of where you were going with uh this, this wonderful palette of sound.
Yeah, Cannonball sensed that. I think that’s why he wrote that piece. He was a very savvy person.
